sources.title: Crotronics Firestarter — eastside music supply
sources.excerpt: Eastside Music Supply's exact Crotronics Firestarter product page reproduces the builder's description of the pedal as a Big Muff-based fuzz created initially as a custom pedal for guitarist Blake Doyle. The description identifies blend, symmetrical/asymmetrical clipping selection and a Choke control for starved-voltage gating, while explicitly naming the pedal Crotronics Firestarter.
